name: USD.AI
oneLiner: USDai is USD.AI's non-yielding base dollar, minted 1:1 from USDC/USDT and separately stakeable into sUSDai for GPU-loan yield.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDai resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

collateral: USDai is the non-yielding base token of USD.AI, currently backed 1:1 by PayPal's PYUSD stablecoin held in the USDai contract (live proof-of-reserves shows the entire base reserve is PYUSD on Arbitrum). USDC/USDT serve as retail deposit and secondary-market exit currencies, not the reserve asset. Yield and GPU-collateralized loan exposure accrue to staked sUSDai, not to base USDai.
pegMechanism: USDai is minted and redeemed 1:1 against its PYUSD reserve via the contract deposit()/withdraw() functions; direct mint/redeem is KYC-gated to whitelisted institutions, with no withdrawal queue. Retail users deposit USDC/USDT and can exit via supported currencies. Staking into the yield-bearing sUSDai vault is optional.

genius.notes: USDai supports whitelisted direct mint/redeem flows, but no public GENIUS approval, application, or foreign registration was located.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS approval, official application, or foreign registration source was located for USDai; direct mint/redeem is now whitelisted.

mintAuthority.summary: USDai is minted by KYC'ed institutions depositing stablecoins (PYUSD) into the USDai contract's deposit() function, which mints 1:1; privileged protocol operations run under role-based access (STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE executed by a multisig, BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE for omnichain mint/burn), with a stated future transition to DAO governance.

controls.label: USDai deposit/mint contract (KYC-gated deposit())
controls.evidence: Per USD.AI technical docs, KYC'ed institutions call deposit(uint256 depositAmount, uint256 usdaiAmountMinimum) to transfer PYUSD into the USDai contract, which mints equivalent USDai; minting is gated to KYC'ed institutions rather than fully permissionless.

controls.label: STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE (multisig)
controls.evidence: STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE governs position managers and services redemptions; per USD.AI docs these operations are currently scheduled off-chain and executed by a multisig, with a stated future move to on-chain governance.

review.evidence: USD.AI technical docs confirm USDai is minted via a contract deposit() function by KYC'ed institutions depositing PYUSD (1:1), not by a fiat issuer backend. Privileged operations use STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE (currently a multisig) and BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE for omnichain mint/burn; governance is slated to move to the USD.AI DAO. This is the parent of sUSDai (susdai-usd-ai).
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mint mechanism and role model confirmed from USD.AI first-party docs; the live multisig address, signer set, and threshold for STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE were not independently resolved on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE multisig address, signer count, and threshold, plus the on-chain USDai contract owner/upgrade admin, before raising to verified.
